articles.title: Drakong’s New Attack on Titan-Themed Collectible Controllers Come In a Blind Box
articles.summary: Drakong, a sub-brand of Hyperkin, today announced the PixelByte controller range, a new line of collectible controllers themed after Attack on Titan. These cute, keychain-sized controllers look a bit like a pixelated NES controller paired with one of several characters from Attack on Titan, and…
body: Despite their size, layout, and distribution method, the PixelByte controllers are fully functional, compatible with PC, Switch 1 and 2, iOS, Android, and other Bluetooth devices. They offer approximately 12 hours of wireless gameplay, and are rechargeable via USB-C.

Each PixelByte blind box contains one of seven possible variants, pairing a unique colorway with a chibi charm of Attack on Titan characters like Eren, Mikasa, Levi, and Hange. There's also one rare chase variant that's found at a lower rate than the rest.

I can't say that a blind box is the most idea way to buy a controller, so I doubt the PixelByte line will make our list of the best controllers for PC or Switch, but I could see the appeal from the collectible side of things. I'm personally not one for blind boxes, but my Pokémon card collection will attest that I'm very familiar with the concept of cracking open physical loot boxes at the prospect of scoring something rare and shiny.
The PixelByte controllers are available for pre-order now for $24.99 per box.
articles.author: Bo Moore

articles.title: Baptiste’s New Trailer Proves You Should Never, Ever Trust A Creepy Doll
articles.summary: Horror movies have long warned us of the perils of puppets, and that's a vibe you'll explore firsthand in upcoming horror game Baptiste. A vessel for evil--according to the totally scientific research of Annabelle and all those Chucky movies--there's nothing worse than a puppet that has had its…
body: Taking place after a family tragedy, the game is set at Jagged Shore Cliff, a remote location where a mother and her son attempt a new start in life. It's not long before the duo discovers a dusty cabinet that holds an unsettling doll inside, ignores the warning never to release it, and then watches as all hell breaks loose. With sinister forces assaulting their grip on sanity, it's up to players to guide the protagonist, Tom, to safety while navigating a suffocating atmosphere and oppressive darkness.

Still suffering from the loss of his family, Tom must uncover gruesome secrets, solve puzzles, and stay a step ahead of the supernatural forces--and that damn doll--before it claims his soul in this story-driven psychological-horror game. There's no release date for it yet, but it is headed to PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Switch 2.
articles.author: Darryn Bonthuys

articles.title: Xbox Game Pass Is Losing The Witcher 3 And Several More Games In August
articles.summary: Another batch of Xbox Game Pass titles are on their way out at the end of the month, and it looks like the service will be losing some cool, cute, and critically acclaimed games.
body: Listed on the "Leaving Soon" tab on the Xbox mobile app, the list includes the following five games exiting the subscription service on August 31: Another Crab's Treasure, I Am Your Beast, Neon Abyss, One Lonely Outpost, and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Complete Edition. As usual, you can save 20% on these games if you decide to buy them before they leave Game Pass. Another Crab's Treasure is a cute take on the souls-like genre, I Am Your Beast plays like a first-person version of Hotline Miami, and Neon Abyss is a slick, action-packed 2D roguelike platformer.
articles.author: Darryn Bonthuys

articles.title: 'No Disc No Buy' Comments Dominate Sony's Phantom Blade Zero State of Play Livestream, as Planned PlayStation Boycott Nears
articles.summary: Sony held its planned Phantom Blade Zero State of Play livestream with — somewhat surprisingly — the comments turned on, and they went exactly how everyone thought they would.
body: The YouTube chat, for example, was dominated by “no disc no buy” comments, which drowned out comments about the promising looking action game itself. It was a similar situation on Twitch.

None of this should come as a surprise, given fans had called out this first State of Play since Sony’s announcement sent shockwaves through the video game industry as a likely battleground for the ongoing backlash to the impending end of PlayStation disc production from 2028.

“Will buy when it's available PHYSICALLY,” read one comment. “Wow! It may look great but it will look better on a disc! So make that happen and keep happening,” said another. “Does Donnie Yen come on disc?” joked one person.
articles.author: Wesley Yin-Poole

articles.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is 'Reimagining' The Series' Original Game With a Focus Meter, Skill Tree and Herb Brewing
articles.summary: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis will include an RPG-like skill tree, herb brewing and a new chargeable focus meter in its reimagining of the series' first game. The remake, which is in development at Trek to Yomi studio Flying Wild Hog, in collaboration with the series' lead studio Crystal…
body: A new video detailing Legacy of Atlantis' combat and progression has now gone into detail on this gameplay, which includes elements inspired by the more recent Tomb Raider reboot trilogy. For example, a skill tree has been revealed that shows how players will redeem in-game artifacts for skill points, which unlock a web of weapon upgrades and ability improvements. These include reduced damage and improved healing. You can also collect and brew herbs for various buffs.

"When I played the Survivor series and I could suddenly affect and increase Lara's power in the game, I felt much more engaged," design director Jason Epps said. Another new system, Focus, will allow players to pull off some of Lara Croft's more acrobatic manoeuvers and also go into a kind of bullet time, game director Raul Siqueira revealed.
articles.author: Tom Phillips

articles.title: Battlefield 6 is hosting a free trial, just in time for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's beta
articles.summary: Battlefield 6 's latest free trial kicks off today alongside Season 4's mid-season update, and while that mightn't be especially notable in itself, the timing is moreso: it coincides with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's highly anticipated, and stuffed, beta.
body: Modern Warfare 4's first beta session, which was announced in July, kicks off this Friday, 21st August and runs until Tuesday, 25th August. This means there's some overlap with Battlefield 6's newly announced free trial, which starts today and continues until Tuesday, 25th August. So if you're interested in playing both games, there's actually plenty of time to try out Battlefield 6 before jumping into Modern Warfare 4 over the weekend.

Battlefield Studios has, of course, hosted similar free trials to coincide with major Battlefield 6 updates in the past, but Call of Duty and Battlefield also have a history of this kind of counter-programming. Last year, Black Ops 6 held a week-long free trial coinciding with Battlefield 6's release week. A little over one month later, Battlefield 6 returned the favour by going free for a week shortly after the disappointing launch of Black Ops 7. So Battlefield's latest free trial perhaps isn't all that coincidental.
articles.author: Sherif Saed

articles.title: Do Not Boycott GTA 6, Fired Rockstar Workers Tell Fans: 'There’s a Better Way to Support Us and Hold Rockstar to Account'
articles.summary: The first Rockstar workers who are embroiled in a legal battle with the company have told fans they shouldn’t boycott GTA 6 to protest on their behalf.
body: With GTA 6 due out in November, and the final hearing of the workers’ proceedings against Rockstar set to begin in Glasgow next month, the Independent Workers’ Union of Great Britain (IWGB) asked backers to buy T-shirts to help fund the legal battle instead.

Rockstar has insisted the employees it fired late last year were dismissed because they leaked game features for upcoming and unannounced titles in Discord, not because they were trying to unionize. 34 members of staff at Rockstar were dismissed — 31 in the UK and three in Canada — sparking protests outside the office of GTA 6 developer Rockstar North in Edinburgh, Scotland, and outside parent company Take-Two’s office in London.
articles.author: Wesley Yin-Poole

articles.title: 'We Were Robbed': Toy Story 5 Deleted Scene Showed Jessie and Bullseye's First Meeting
articles.summary: Toy Story 5 was once set to feature a flashback showing the first meeting between Jessie and Bullseye, before the sequence was cut. A hand-drawn version of this deleted scene will be included in the home release of Toy Story 5, which will be available digitally on August 18, and via 4K Ultra HD…
body: While the scene apparently never made it as far as being 3D animated, it survives in the form of dialogue, rough 2D animation and sound effects that recreate the sequence for viewers to enjoy — and to find out more about Bullseye's past.

In a flashback to just before the events of Toy Story 2, Jessie would have been shown meeting Bullseye after he becomes part of Al's collection. (Al, the villain of Toy Story 2, wanted to collect all four cowboy dolls from Woody's Round-Up and sell them to a buyer in Japan.) It's here that Jessie would have learned of Bullseye's past owner while trying to calm him down.

Like Jessie's previous child owner Emily, Bullseye would have been shown wearing the name of his previous owner Charlie. Both toys eventually bond over now being alone, and Jessie promises to help Bullseye find his home one day.
"Why scrap it, it's so good," wrote one Toy Story fan on social media. "Oh we were robbed," said another. "Wish they kept this in the movie," said a third.
articles.author: Tom Phillips

articles.title: Guillermo del Toro's Most Disgusting Sci-Fi Thriller Is Officially Streaming For Free
articles.summary: Guillermo del Toro has earned his place as the keeper of the monster movie genre. Through a 40-year career that has taken him from Mexico to Spain to the US, del Toro has consistently crafted three-dimensional monsters, whether they’re frightening children or taking unexpected turns as romantic…
body: His first Hollywood movie, released in 1997, was a troubled production. Mimic follows an entomologist (Mira Sorvino) who creates a special breed of insects to counteract a deadly pandemic. The creature ends up mutating into a horrifying human-sized predator called the Long John. It’s streaming for free on Tubi, making this the perfect chance to watch some of the most disturbing bugs ever captured on camera as they threaten to overtake New York City.

Del Toro has publicly described the making of Mimic as one of the worst experiences of his life and the reason why he almost quit working in Hollywood. “It was a horrible, horrible, horrible experience,” he told The Independent in 2018. “I was interfered with in plot, in casting, in the type of action. They second-guessed all the time. I never had a single day that was pleasant.” The film was produced by Dimension Films, the horror and sci-fi subdivision of Miramax Films, with del Toro clashing repeatedly with Harvey Weinstein over its direction.
articles.author: Maria Loreto

articles.title: The true story behind BioShock Infinite's Bread Boy
articles.summary: BioShock Infinite's Bread Boy went viral on Twitter in February, so we asked developer Gwen Frey to weigh in on how exactly she made this king of crumb. The reasons the Bread Boy exists in the Burial at Sea DLC point to the strange, specific problems that developers have to overcome every day.
articles.author: Simone de Rochefort

articles.title: Resident Evil Requiem's Grace Ashcroft actor reportedly replacing Jennifer English as lead of lavish Chinese action game Tides of Annihilation
articles.summary: Lavish Chinese action game Tides of Annihilation seems to have found a replacement for Jennifer English, the award-winning actor who withdrew from voicing the game's main character Gwendolyn last month.
body: This isn't 100 percent confirmed, but a recent gameplay demo shown in China in Shanghai displayed a different look for protagonist Gwendolyn - and a different voice. Comments underneath the video suspected Sant'Albano as the voice, and this suspicion was given credulity by Gwendolyn motion-capture performer Jennifer Prime.

Prime shared the Tides of Annihilation gameplay video on X, and in a comment response to someone, who claimed the voice was Grace Ashcroft, said, "Yep!!! But this time, no more screaming 'LEON!!!!'" Prime has since been mentioned in a number of retweets and stands by their comment. I'm trying to contact the game's developer, Eclipse Glow Games, for confirmation.

Jennifer English - famed for her work on Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 as Maelle, and for her role in Baldur's Gate 3 as Shadowheart - left the Tides of Annihilation cast in June "due to personal health reasons", the game's social media accounts revealed. However, she was said to be supporting the game in an advisory role and in helping find "talented performers who could carry Gwendolyn forward".
articles.author: Robert Purchese

articles.title: Dad game review round-up
articles.summary: Games are for dads. Thanks to video games, dads can play golf, build birdhouses, mow the lawn, and go fishing... all without leaving the home office. But what do games like Powerwash Simulator, Train Sim World 2, and The Golf Club have to offer the childless urban-dwelling millennial?
articles.author: Patrick Gill

articles.title: Time loops are a weird genre for an anxious time
articles.summary: Time loop games have become a trend over the past few years: from Twelve Minutes, to Outer Wilds, to Deathloop. But the genre is by no means new! It predates Groundhog Day and goes all the way back to World War II. Still, there's a reason time loop stories keep coming back... looping, if you will.
articles.author: Jenna Stoeber

articles.title: It turns out touching grass is the answer: Gaming is great when you leave the house
articles.summary: Hello! This piece is a part of Optimism Week on Eurogamer - a week of features either about optimism itself or those which hope to inspire it. For more articles like this, you can visit our Optimism Week hub. Thank you as ever for reading!
body: I don't think it's much of a secret to say gaming, as a primary hobby, can be incredibly isolating. Not always, but often. The older I have become, the more I have come to realise that games are best experienced with other people. Not just through Discord, or some in-game guild, but out in the real world.

I can speak to this from experience. I have locked myself in a room during the launch of a World of Warcraft expansion. I pulled many a sick day grinding out medals in Gears of War 3 back at school. And I have spent months at a time trying to convince myself that the latest fighting game release would be the one I finally get really good at.

All of these experiences were brilliant, and I have no desire to leave them behind. One of the worst parts of this job is knowing that when Guild Wars 3 or the next Armored Core game comes out, my boss will know any claims of food poisoning are phony. One of the best parts, however, is attending in-person gaming events. These days, they're what I look forward to most.
articles.author: Connor Makar

articles.title: Be warned: Fallout 4's next update may break your mods - and there's a similar one for Skyrim in the works, too
articles.summary: For most games, the news of a new patch is usually received with excitement. This is true for games made by Bethesda too, of course, but not when they're as old as Fallout 4 and Skyrim are. The reason? Mods.
body: Bethesda announced that a new update for Fallout 4 Creations (mods) will arrive today, 18th August to deliver "general improvements". In the patch's announcement on X, the developer advised players to log in and back up their save files, or manually save the load order of their mods before installing the patch as a precaution.

That's because, as anyone who plays the mod-friendly games of Bethesda knows, patches have a tendency to break mods. This is pretty typical, as mods are built to work with whatever version of the game was available when they were released. Even though patches may not directly alter some underlying feature a mod is built on, a new version number is enough to cause a disruption.

Again, this is nothing new for players who have been modding Bethesda games for years: the solution is for the mod's creator to release an updated version that works with the post-patch game, which is sometimes easier said than done when the creator has simply abandoned the project.
articles.author: Sherif Saed

articles.title: Disappointing 'Fortnite' Chapter 7 Season 4 Battle Pass Will at Least Give Players a Sonic Skin
articles.summary: Epic Games has been extensively teasing Fortnite Override, also known as Chapter 7 Season 4. One of the recent teasers has revealed all eight skins that will be available with the launch of Fortnite Override on Aug. 20.
body: The upcoming Battle Pass was announced in a fun, 8-bit trailer made by Studio 64 Bits, an animation studio from the Netherlands. The trailer shows Jonesy visiting multiple video game worlds to recruit fighters to help him battle Geno. At the end, we see a character selection screen featuring classic Fortnite characters, such as Jonesy, Cuddle Team Leader, Peely, and Raven, as well as the skins coming in Chapter 7 Season 4.

The Chapter 7 Season 4 Battle Pass will feature eight skins: Bastian, Grace Crowne, K1TTYW1NS, Wrixel, Mali, Phantom, Geno, and Sonic. The order in which they're shown in the trailer will likely indicate the order in which they will be unlocked in-game. If so, this means that Sonic will be the last obtainable character in the Battle Pass and will require players to reach Level 100 to unlock him in Fortnite.
articles.author: Ashely Claudino

articles.title: 20-year-old Gunz the Duel gets Steam re-release, receives harsh criticism over network issues and suspected use of generative AI
articles.summary: Gunz the Duel, the cult classic 3rd-person action game first released back in 2006, is back on Steam. But the long-awaited return of the genre-defining game has been tarred somewhat by technical issues, and allegations of AI usage.
body: Gunz the Duel was first developed by MAIET Entertainment, but has been brought to modern platforms by Masangsoft. This resurrection of Gunz the Duel has been in the works for a few years, and has built up organic hype from older PC players with fond memories of Gunz.

However, with the game releasing on Steam over the weekend, expectations were met with reality, and a wave of criticisms hit Gunz the Duel. For one, the game is reportedly suffering from significant technical issues.

"Masangsoft is a group of talented individuals. Not only did they manage to ruin a 20 year old game, but they consistently discover new ways to make it worse," wrote user Fizzion. They go on to say that in-game events and gifts aren't working properly, and that the beloved gameplay experience itself is different than it was in the original title. They explain: "When slashing a blocking enemy - even with angles taken into consideration - flinching/stagger almost never happens and seems very inconsistent."
articles.author: Connor Makar

articles.title: The RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB currently costs more than the RTX 5070 and RX 9070 XT, and I know which one I'd pick
articles.summary: Jacob earned his first byline writing for his own tech blog, before graduating to breaking things professionally at PCGamesN, where he was one half of a popular weekly YouTube show.
body: Prices for graphics cards are still on the rise. Just last week, we noted prices were at the worst we've seen them in the past 12 months, but after further checks this morning, they're looking worse again still.

Among the worst offenders, the RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB. With memory being the main driving factor of price hikes in the past 12 months, it's perhaps no surprise that this memory-laden card is rising faster than most. Yet prices are beyond the pale.

In my search for a brand new card from a reputable retailer, this was the cheapest I could find: an MSI Shadow RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB for $780. Not only is that more expensive than the best value RTX 5070 I could find at $763, but it's far in excess of AMD's RX 9070 XT. That's just $720. It's also in excess of the RTX 5060 Ti 8 GB, which I've found at $430. A $350 premium for the 16 GB model.

There's little reason to purchase an RTX 5060 Ti for gaming at that price. It wasn't even a card I liked much at MSRP. I like lots of VRAM as much as the next guy, and it makes a difference to the overall performance, but there's a limit to how much I'd be willing to spend to get it.
articles.author: Jacob Ridley

articles.title: Chinese RAM hits 9000 MT/s and even matches the speed and latency of the memory in our western gaming PCs
articles.summary: On the one hand, given the global memory shortage and astronomical RAM prices, it's hard to get excited about any news from the memory industry. On the other hand, there's always the chance that developments could alleviate some of the supply strain, and today we have the latter: Chinese memory has…
body: That's according to Colorful, which shared the accomplishment on Chinese social media site Weibo (via TechPowerUp ).

The company says: "Following its impressive overclocking results of 8600 MT/s and 8800 MT/s, the Colorful iGame X870E VULCAN W OC motherboard has achieved another breakthrough, successfully reaching a high frequency of 9000 MT/s when paired with iGame Shadow II 24G×2 domestically produced memory chips, unlocking a new height in the overclocking field of domestically produced memory chips on the AM5 platform."

So, that's 48 GB of "domestically produced", ie, Chinese, DDR5 RAM hitting 9,000 MT/s. Admittedly, we're far beyond that with Western memory, having hit over 8,700 MT/s all the way back in 2021 and 10,000 MT/s the following year. Now, we're at over 13,000 MT/s.

Still, 9,000 is an achievement for Chinese memory and shows how fast the country is progressing in its DRAM development. In fact, Asus ROG also recently shared that Chinese memory now works at 6,000 MT/s with low CAS latency timings of C28 and C30. Notably, this is exactly the kind of fast DDR5 RAM we like to buy for gaming PCs in the West: DDR5-6000 memory with low latency.
articles.author: Jacob Fox

articles.title: Death Stranding meets party-based tactical combat in open world RPG Fog'n'Silence, in which you lead twisted humans through the Afterlife
articles.summary: On viewing the trailer for Fog'n'Silence, I transformed instantly into a caricature of a Texan oilman. "Hoowee!!" I whooped, hurling down my ten gallon hat and firing my ivory-handled six shooter into the air.
body: Created by Kyiv-based Hello Andromeda, this is a grim and enveloping party-based open world RPG that, according to studio co-founder Vlad Muntian, takes inspiration from Kenshi, Death Stranding, and Outer Wilds. It puts you in charge of a group of Vagrants exploring the vast plains of the Afterlife. You'll deal with transmogrifying fog, sneak around blind monsters, tackle esoteric physics, and (if you must) take part in freeze-time combat that sees Vagrants and adversaries plotting actions, then playing them out simultaneously. All the while dealing with lasting injuries, mounting hunger, and rapidly decreasing sanity.

You control everything by means of a flying drone, which makes for some panoramic presentation, with pathetically tiny humanoids in Hazmats scurrying over miles of sickly sand, rock and… skin? Yeah, pretty sure that's skin. Also pretty sure one of your party members has two heads. Look at your minions go, picking a path among lurid fractal meshes, concrete ribcages, and fields of metallic follicles. Hoowee! (hat, sixshooter, etc) I have got to get me some of those fields of metallic follicles!!
articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
